limitations: Configuration/launch/file evidence only; no ordinary-background classifications or timing eligibility.
Environment values and literal command arguments are not serialized; argv digests/counts retained.
Bare commands are not resolved using the observer PATH; absent and nonregular files stay unverified.
Interpreted scripts, loaded executable images/libraries, timer scheduling and transient scopes require separate review.
Snapshots and rechecks are sequential; no continuous configuration or host-isolation guarantee.
Earlier failed and partial captures remain separate evidence, not overwritten successful observations.
